llm_request:
Translate the following Chinese text into professional English, suitable for an academic resume or personal statement:

"During my undergraduate studies at Harbin Engineering University, my GPA ranked in the top 5%, and I was awarded the University-level Academic Excellence Award. While completing my integrated Master's degree in New and Renewable Energy at Durham University, I also achieved excellent grades, won the First-Class Scholarship, and was recognized as an Outstanding Graduate of the department. Additionally, throughout my studies, I actively participated in scientific research projects and published related papers."

Please refine the English translation to ensure it sounds natural, professional, and impactful.
llm_response:
Here are a few ways to refine your translation, depending on where exactly you plan to use it. 

### Option 1: For a Personal Statement (Fluid & Impactful)
*This option connects your achievements smoothly and uses strong academic verbs, making it ideal for a paragraph in a cover letter or personal statement.*

> "During my undergraduate studies at Harbin Engineering University, I graduated in the top 5% of my class and was honored with the University Academic Excellence Award. I subsequently pursued an integrated Master’s degree in New and Renewable Energy at Durham University, where I maintained a record of academic excellence. My performance there earned me the First-Class Scholarship and the title of Outstanding Graduate of the Department. Concurrently, I actively engaged in scientific research, culminating in the publication of related academic papers."

### Option 2: For an Academic Resume / CV (Action-Oriented)
*If you need this for a summary section at the top of a CV, it is best to remove the "I" pronouns and get straight to the point.*

> "Graduated in the top 5% of the undergraduate class at Harbin Engineering University, earning the University-level Academic Excellence Award. Subsequently completed an integrated Master’s degree in New and Renewable Energy at Durham University with distinguished academic standing. Recognized as an Outstanding Graduate and awarded the First-Class Scholarship. Demonstrates a strong commitment to research, having actively contributed to scientific projects resulting in peer-reviewed publications."

### Option 3: Short & Punchy (Elevator Pitch style)
*Best if you have a strict word limit.*

> "I ranked in the top 5% of my undergraduate cohort at Harbin Engineering University, earning a University Academic Excellence Award. I later completed an integrated Master's in New and Renewable Energy at Durham University with high distinction, receiving a First-Class Scholarship and the Outstanding Graduate award. Throughout my academic career, I have complemented my coursework by actively participating in research projects and publishing my findings."

### Key Refinements Made:
*   **"GPA ranked in the top 5%"**: Changed to *"top 5% of my class/cohort"* or *"graduated in the top 5%"*. In native English academic writing, class rank is more commonly used than explicitly mentioning the GPA acronym in prose.
*   **"Completing... also achieved excellent grades"**: Upgraded to *"maintained a record of academic excellence"* or *"with high distinction"*. This sounds much more professional than "achieved excellent grades."
*   **"Throughout my studies"**: Upgraded to *"concurrently"* or *"throughout my academic career"* for better flow.
*   **"Published related papers"**: Changed to *"publication of related academic papers"* or *"publishing my findings."* Adding the word "findings" or "academic" makes the research sound more rigorous.
